name: Aarti Surfactants Ltd
tagline: Small-cap surfactants maker demerged from Aarti Industries' home-and-personal-care division - weak return ratios (ROE ~5.2%, ROCE ~8.5%) despite decent revenue growth put this well below the quality bar for a fundamentals thesis.
business_overview: Aarti Surfactants Ltd was formed via the demerger of Aarti Industries' home & personal care (HPC) division, producing ionic and non-ionic surfactants and specialty products for Home & Personal Care, Industrial, Agro and Oil-industry customers. As a recently demerged entity it is still a standalone small-cap with a limited independent track record.
fundamentals_narrative: Revenue growth of ~12.3% is respectable but return ratios are weak for a specialty-chemicals business - ROE of ~5.2% and ROCE of ~8.5% sit well below the >=15% quality threshold this framework looks for, suggesting either post-demerger integration drag, thin/commodity-like surfactant margins, or both. Surfactants are a largely commoditized, price-competitive intermediate chemical with limited pricing power outside a few specialty grades; no specific moat (patents, long-term sole-supply agreements, or brand) was identified for this entity in this pass. Being a young standalone listing (post-demerger), the track record is also too short to independently validate consistency.
